ValidationRule.description: Prevents changing the Order Owner for Sales Director. Also prevents the current record owner from reassigning
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", OR( $Permission.Restrict_Order_Owner_Change, PRIORVALUE(OwnerId) = $User.Id ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to change the Order Owner. Please contact your Revenue Operation Team or Salesforce Administrator if this needs to be updated.
